checks.name: Presentation rate is bounded on 60, 120 and 144 Hz displays; static screens redraw only on changes
Adaptive resolution responds to sustained load, recovers slowly, and keeps manual quality available
All 11 robot shapes keep every triangle, UV seam and normal after vertex indexing
Inactive battery flames issue no buffer uploads and active flames still move and light the robot
Instanced graphics buffers are released when a scene is replaced
Static menus reuse shadows; moving robots and replays refresh medium shadows at 30 Hz
Idle audio suspends once and resumes through the existing start flow
Skipping unseen tournament recordings preserves exact seeded physical state and damage
Tournament work yields after its time budget and continues the same match

graphics: Geometry and DOM checks do not measure GPU frame rate.
